name: The Heir
pitch: Your last years buy one debt with your life, and whoever you raised inherits the rest: the Book, the name everyone fears, and one dead face for every head before them, until a child at the end owes nothing.
channel: art hit, with Slow Wound under Paid in Seasons in each head's last fight

new.name: The Named Heir
new.effect: A rider on The Set Day: name a disciple, and at death continue as them in the same world, with the Book, the tally and one mask per dead head. Closes your tree, your realm and your player edge.

new.name: Grave Goods
new.effect: At a handover, half of Eaten Power goes into the ground with the head. With a life eating E, handover power closes on E.
new.second_home: any inherited power, any sect treasure that weakens on passing

new.name: Lien
new.effect: Each living entry in your Book reserves 5 % of maximum linh lực, to 30 %.
new.second_home: any debtor, any oath that holds power in escrow

new.name: Ancestor's Face
new.effect: One mask per dead head. Each fight, each stops one hit sized 8 % of your health or more, whole, with nothing drained.

new.name: The Name Arrives First
new.effect: An enemy your tally frightens (5, 20, 50, 200, 1,000 for Qi Refining to Deity) carries an exit that stays shut until a blow of theirs falls on a mask, then opens at once.
new.second_home: any infamous NPC, any sect with a bad name

new.name: Succession
new.effect: A mode of Codex & Karmic Carryover (#12): with a Named Heir alive at your death, the next life continues as them in this world. Passes Book, tally, half of Eaten Power, masks, stones and heirlooms. Heart demon, tree and the player's edge stay behind, and the heir crosses gates on their NPC edge score.
new.second_home: The Given Years' Long Table, a Herd-Child's beast left to a grandchild

questions: Does the player's edge follow the player or the first body? This sheet says it stays behind, and an heir reads their NPC edge score.
A new life is a new world in the game concept. Is one exception for Succession acceptable?
Heart demon does not pass, which reopens the Nascent gate The Not-Yet-Full closes. Each entry counts +1. Is that the right leak?
Masks stop any blow for free, the critic's first finding again. A death pays for each here. Is that a price?
